## What changed?

Describe the user-visible result and link the related issue.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any checks you could not run. For a visual change, describe the phone and desktop viewports you reviewed.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I checked for local paths, credentials, personal information and sensitive screenshots.
- [ ] I added or updated coverage for new behavior where practical.
- [ ] I kept external data sources labelled and local node status distinct from indexed history.
